dependencies.name: archebase-vi-guide
dependencies.authority: brand facts, official assets, evidence, tokens, route playbooks and release gates
dependencies.resolution: Install or clone from the GitHub repository with --branch v3.5.4 and verify rev-parse HEAD against the pinned commit. A local filesystem checkout is a cache, not the canonical identity.
dependencies.update_policy: Do not float to main. Update tag/commit only after running the nine upstream validators named in SKILL.md plus evals/check_brand_facts.py and evals/run_visual_design_benchmark.py.

dependencies.name: archebase-wechat-layout
dependencies.authority: channel implementation for the WeChat layout rules in references/channel-wechat.md only; never a brand authority
dependencies.resolution: Clone from the GitHub repository and check out the pinned commit. The repository has no tags yet, so the commit is the only pinnable identity.
dependencies.update_policy: Re-verify every rule in references/channel-wechat.md against assets/archebase-wechat-safe.css before advancing the commit.

dependencies.name: design-ir-store
dependencies.authority: derived retrieval corpus and design-space tooling only; its records are not VI evidence and must never be cited as brand authority
dependencies.resolution: Resolve from the environment variable ARCHEBASE_DESIGN_IR, else from the sibling directory ../archebase-design-ir relative to this skill, else by cloning the GitHub repository at the pinned commit. Verify git rev-parse HEAD against the pin before using it as the corpus identity; a local checkout is a cache. If unreachable or the identity does not match, stop the Design IR route and record 待确认.
dependencies.update_policy: Regenerate the index (build_index.py) after any record change, then re-run evals/run_visual_design_benchmark.py; advance the pinned commit only together with a record change that passes the store's own validators.

non_goals: Do not copy the VI skill into this repository.
Do not vendor VI tokens, evidence, logos, validators or release gates.
Do not reconstruct brand facts from local PDFs, CSS, marketing material or memory.
Do not treat the Design IR store, its annotations or its embeddings as brand authority.
